text: そのバッジ…　リーダー　から　もらったんでしょ　…　しってるわよ

structure.jp: リーダー　から　もらったんでしょ
structure.en: you got them from Gym Leaders, didn't you

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の (here shortened to ん) after a verb shows the speaker is explaining or checking the story behind something. もらったんでしょ = 'the thing is, you got them, right?'

patterns.name: 〜でしょう
patterns.explanation: でしょう, here cut short to でしょ, asks the listener to agree with what the speaker already believes. もらったんでしょ = 'you got them, didn't you?'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state is going on now; しる 'get to know' becomes 'know'. It is shortened to てる in casual speech. しってる = 'I know'.
